Subject: Acme - SOC 2 + audit logs discussion — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the thorough discussion. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum:

Summary of Acme goals / pain points you shared:
- Need a SOC 2 Type II report and supporting evidence for upcoming vendor review (deadline: end of Q3).
- Audit log fidelity: must include per-request metadata (requestor, timestamp, model id, prompt hash) and retention for at least 12 months; legal prefers 36 months for high-risk data.
- Data residency & retention controls: want options for region-based retention and export for audits.
- DPA + contractual terms: standard DPA in place, but Acme has a few redlines around data retention and incident notification timing.
- Pen test evidence: need recent penetration test summary and remediation timeline.

What Redwood can provide (high-level):
- SOC 2 Type II report (we can share the 2026 report under NDA) and a controls matrix mapping to your questionnaire.
- Audit logs: streaming delivery to your S3 or long-term archival; default retention 90 days with configurable extensions (90/365/1095 days).
- DPA & Data retention: standard DPA + addenda for extended retention on a per-account basis; incident notification 24 hours for critical incidents.
- Pen test: executive summary and mitigation log; full pentest report available on a per-request basis under NDA.

Attachments I dropped here: acme_soc2_questions.xlsx (your completed questionnaire placeholder). I attached our internal SOC2 report and a short PDF on retention options for quick reference — will share the full SOC2 under NDA.

Next steps proposed:
1) I will upload the SOC2 executive summary + retention options PDF to the Drive link below (by end of day).
2) Rishi (cc'd) to follow up with technical details on audit-log schema and how we can stream to Acme's S3 bucket.
3) Schedule a 30-min technical call next week with your security team to walk the logs and DPA redlines. Please propose 2 times that work for Sarah/John.

If anything above is off, flag it. Otherwise we'll proceed with the items above.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0138

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and mirrors our notes. A couple of clarifications / additional asks from our security team:

- Can you confirm whether audit logs include the raw prompt text or whether you redact/store prompt hashes by default? Our legal team will want to understand PII controls.
- For retention: 12 months is our baseline, but for data tied to payments or PII we may need 36 months. We need a pricing/ops note on cost for extended retention.
- DPA: we'll send a redline PDF with our changes to the retention and deletion clauses. Any initial views on those are helpful.
- Pen test: please share the date of the last external pentest and the cadence of future testing. Also if you have Mitre ATT&CK mapping for findings, that would speed our review.

Can we do a technical call Friday at 10am PT or Monday 1pm PT? Sarah and I prefer Monday if that works.

John — quick technical follow-up from our side (happy to go deeper on the call):

- Prompts & PII: By default, we store full request text in encrypted logs for 90 days. For accounts with enhanced retention we can store raw prompts up to 36 months in encrypted S3 with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and access controls. We can also provide prompt hashing and redaction patterns on ingest if you prefer not to store raw text.
- Audit log schema: we can emit the following fields: timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, user_id (internal/customer id), model_id, token_count, prompt_hash, response_id, node_region, latency_ms, decision_routing (model variant). We can include HTTP headers and IPs on request if required for forensics. Example schema and sample JSON attached.
- Streaming & retention: we support push to your S3 (preferred) or pull via secure API. Default retention on Redwood-managed logs is 90 days; extended retention options: 365 days (+pricing), 1095 days (+pricing). We will include a cost estimate in the follow-up.
- SOC2 & pen test: SOC2 Type II (period ending 2026-12-31) executive summary is attached. Last third-party pentest was 2026-09; exec summary and Mitre mapping included in the pentest package (available under NDA).

Suggested next steps:
- Marissa to schedule the technical call Monday 2027-06-21 13:00 PT (pending confirmation).
- I'll prepare a short doc mapping our controls to Acme's questionnaire and include sample audit-log JSON and S3 config instructions.

Thanks —
Rishi
Staff Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
